decisions.reason: KiCad 9 library-variable compatibility does not change component sourcing, availability, or cost-selection policies.
The path-variable issue affects project portability, not the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector layout.
The source decision concerns KiCad library references and does not alter BOM contents, part numbers, or assembly readiness.
KiCad library-variable compatibility does not change the required JLCPCB ordering assistance or order-setup process.
The source identifies a portability defect in KiCad library references but does not change the required sensor-board production-file set.
The KiCad 9 path-variable requirement does not alter any main-board mechanical placement or enclosure constraints.
Library-reference portability is independent of the switched 5V rail's electrical behavior and control topology.
The source does not change the standalone USB supply's regulator, capacity, activation, or source-selection requirements.
KiCad-version library compatibility is unrelated to the electrical logic-level compatibility of connected sensors.
The source does not modify the ESP32 module selection, pin breakout, header pitch, or reuse requirements.
Although the portability issue was observed in the integrated-board project, it does not change that board's mechanical layout requirements.
The KiCad library-variable correction does not affect DCDC1 voltage configuration or 3.3V rail regulation.
